replies:
500 USD is about ₹42,000 at a rate of 1 USD = ₹84.00.

I checked the rate four times and it was 84.00 each time. The system labels rates as provisional until they change, and this one never did, so treat the figure as indicative. The final amount may differ slightly when you do the actual conversion, because bank fees and the rate at that moment can change it.
